red_tests.failure_fingerprint: Pytest summary: 3 failed, 1 passed. The capacity policy positive control passed; the release-cycle contracts failed with ModuleNotFoundError for scripts.multiagent_durable_queue, scripts.multiagent_root_worker, and scripts.multiagent_root_supervisor.

correction_reason: The superseded baseline is correctly labeled RECONSTRUCTED because its tests were assembled after untracked source candidates existed, and its red_tests entry is an explicit schema negative control rather than historical red evidence. This QA-owned baseline adds an independently authored release-cycle cohort in a clean worktree from committed HEAD, where the three IDQ runtime modules are absent, and records a genuine missing-module red result without modifying the reconstructed tests or copying the historical source candidates.
rationale: Freeze the smallest coherent release-intended IDQ cohort before source enters this isolated branch. The cohort keeps the existing four-account capacity policy as a passing control, binds a capacity lease to the same queue request and alias, requires worker root policies to match account-local caps without borrowing, and requires the supervisor to start distinct detached Root A and Root B processes. The exact source allowlist is limited to queue, worker, supervisor, and capacity; provider execution, secrets, push, deploy, and release claims remain out of scope.
